verdict.rationale: Reflect's own AI palette (cmd+j) accepts free-form natural-language prompts on highlighted text, with saved custom prompts. Users can also chat with filtered notes to ask questions, and semantic search works without exact words. However, the documented natural-language use is limited to transforming text and answering questions about notes, not operating the app itself (creating, moving, tagging or publishing notes, or navigating). Missing for 10: natural-language control of app actions and navigation, an agentic command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
